flaws: monolingual: only one language variant on disk; lifting_plan: add second variant when needed
name: primitive_contract
rationale: Without a uniform contract, primitives become opaque: a future composition or verification tool cannot reason about them. By requiring the same shape from every primitive — pure transform or stateful syscall, classical or quantum, BLAS kernel or shader — the studio gets a substrate where cards plug into each other mechanically.
statement: Every primitive computational card under cards/computation/ MUST carry a defined contract surface: name, category (one of the 18), statement, contract (inputs, outputs, preconditions, postconditions, side_effects), complexity (time, space; energy optional), alternatives, composes_with, witnesses, and at least one variant. A card missing any of these fields is incomplete and surfaces as `lacking: incomplete_primitive`.
